comparison.objective: Open a spring clip, insert and pin-1-align a chip carrier, then let the clip clamp its safe margin; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-114 tests one-hand spring restraint with the other performing planar insertion and orientation; the candidate tests concentric driver/wrench seating and coordinated countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-114 requires flat, centred, pin-1-aligned placement and released jaw contact; the candidate requires a retained 90° opening, secured nuts, repeated cycles, low drift, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: Holding a spring fixture open during oriented insertion is different from preserving a threaded setpoint while tightening its locknut.
